question: In the freeway or expressway lane-ends sequence in Figure 2C-13, which symbol sign is shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper?
model_answer: Direct Answer: In the freeway/expressway lane-ends sequence (Figure 2C-13, Sheet 1 of 5), the symbol sign shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper is the Lane Ends (W4-2R) symbol sign. It is placed at the advance placement distance (per Table 2C-3) upstream of the taper, while the optional word-message RIGHT LANE ENDS (W9-1R) sign with a 1000 FEET (W16-2P) plaque is located farther upstream. Guidance (recommended): - "The Lane Ends (W4-2) sign should be installed at the advance placement distance in accordance with Table 2C-3." Options (permitted): - The W9-1R (RIGHT LANE ENDS) sign shown upstream of the W4-2R in the figure is labeled "(optional)," consistent with its use as a supplemental warning. Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 2C-13, Sheet 1 (freeway or expressway – lane ends) shows the W4-2R symbol sign as the sign closest to the taper, with the dimension arrow labeled "See Table 2C-3 to determine the advance placement distance" running from the W4-2R location to the start of the taper. [Image 2] The full-page view of Sheet 1 confirms the W4-2R nearest the taper and the W9-1R (optional) with W16-2P "1000 FEET" plaque farther downstream (upstream in travel direction). [Image 5] Sheet 3 (left-lane cases) shows the analogous W4-2L arrangement, confirming the W4-2 sign is the one nearest the taper. [Image 3] Sheet 5 shows a different condition (two lanes merging into one, W4-8/W9-4), not the freeway lane-ends case. [Image 4] Figure 3B-14 similarly shows the W4-2R at the advance placement distance (AP) from the taper, with the W9-1R (optional) upstream. Citations: - Section 2C.47 Support §2 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Support §1 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Guidance §3 (p.186) - Figure 2C-13 (p.185) - Page 226 - Page 228 - Page 608
gold_answer: The W4-2R Lane Ends symbol sign.
